pictures.name: SE1-River-At-Dawn
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, letters, logos or modern objects. The wide river Beas in Punjab just before dawn, mist on the water, a deep blue sky with the first gold at the horizon. An old man in simple white clothes and a white turban, Amar Das, a future Guru, seen only from behind, his face never visible, kneels at the water’s edge filling a large brass water pitcher. Reeds, wet sand, a quiet, devoted mood.

pictures.name: SE2-Long-Walk-Back
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, letters, logos or modern objects. A dirt path between green wheat fields at dawn, leading to a small mud-brick village (Khadur) on the horizon. The same old man in simple white clothes and a white turban, seen only from behind and a little far away, his face never visible, walks slowly with the brass water pitcher balanced on his shoulder. Long gold light, birds lifting, peaceful.

pictures.name: SE3-Stormy-Night
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, letters, logos or modern objects. A dark stormy night in a Punjabi village, rain slanting through blue darkness, wind bending a tree. Beside a simple weaver’s mud hut with a wooden loom under its eaves, the same old man in white clothes and a white turban, seen from behind and far, his face never visible, has fallen to one knee in the mud, both arms still holding the brass pitcher safe and upright. A faint warm glow from the hut’s doorway. Gentle, no injury.

pictures.name: SE4-Weavers-Wife
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, letters, logos or modern objects. Inside a small weaver’s mud hut at night, lit by one small clay oil lamp: a sleepy village woman in a plain shawl, half sitting up on a rope bed, frowning toward the door with a dismissive wave of her hand; her husband the weaver dozes beside a wooden loom with threads strung on it. Through the open doorway, small and far in the blue rain, an old figure in white walks on with a pitcher, seen from behind.

pictures.name: SE5-Home-Of-The-Homeless
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, letters, logos or modern objects. A simple sacred courtyard at Khadur at golden morning light. Seen only from behind, his face never visible, an elder Guru in a saffron robe and turban lays a fine white cloth over the shoulders of the old man in white, who is also seen from behind, head bowed, the brass pitcher resting at his feet. Villagers watch with gentle surprise. Warm, tender, honoring.

pictures.name: SE6-Today-Langar
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative oil painting in the same sacred style (lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light), a modern scene, main subject in the middle. No text, letters or logos. A busy modern gurdwara community kitchen (langar hall) at morning. In the middle, a middle-aged man in a pressed office shirt and a navy turban, sleeves rolled up, chops onions beside a teenage girl with a covered head washing a stack of steel plates; behind them a woman rolls round roti flatbreads and an older man tends big steel pots. Near the door, rows of shoes neatly lined up. Warm steam, gold light, quiet joy.
